core_job: For two people who play classic board games together in person (partners, siblings, a parent and child, roommates): start a two-person game in two taps or fewer and play it to a correct finish, on one phone or on two phones over the same Wi-Fi, with no account and no server. The result is recorded against the right person, for good. The engine is already real and is kept: 23 reducers in lib/core/games, full chess rules at chess.dart:234/316-331, and a host-ordered LAN relay in services/lan_transport.dart and match_controller.dart. Baseline checked: flutter analyze reports 'No issues found!' and flutter test reports '+306: All tests passed!'.
must: M1 One honest catalogue and a 'game table' home. Remove every user-visible 'Tier' (home_screen.dart:12-15, 164-165): the Tier 2 header says 'Wi-Fi · Hotspot', but 5 of those games are one-phone only (game_registry.dart:35-40, 70-71). The home opens with a 'Tonight's rivalry' card with a Rematch button, then a game search field. Board classics get drawn mini-boards instead of emoji.

M3 Share and export with no new native plugin (ios/Podfile.lock already has someone else's uncommitted edits): Copy summary and Copy match log as CSV through Clipboard.setData (RFC 4180 quoting); erase one rivalry or all, each with confirmation.

M8 Honesty: no user-visible 'in this build', 'this build', 'coming soon', 'not available yet', 'Simulator' or 'Tier '. Rewrite game_registry.dart:71, join_lobby_screen.dart:93 and settings_screen.dart:178. No demo data, no seeded rivalries, no remote config, no reviewer, region or date detection, no hidden gestures. Every feature can be reached on a single device.

M9 Trivia depth: go from 15 questions (trivia_battle.dart:110-166) to at least 120 original general-knowledge questions in 6 or more categories, with no health, medical, nutrition, fitness or anatomy content (that belongs to BodyQuest). No question repeats within a match, and both phones still draw the same questions from the seed. If that standard cannot be met, remove Trivia Battle and report which option was taken.
